hints.title: Flush Check
hints.text: If all five cards share the identical suit, the hand is 'Flush'.

hints.title: Rank Multiplicity
hints.text: Count occurrences of each rank. If the maximum count is 3 or more, return 'Three of a Kind'.

hints.title: Pair and High Card
hints.text: If the maximum rank count is 2, return 'Pair'; otherwise return 'High Card'.

hints.title: Sequential Rule Checks Implementation

variables: hand size is fixed at 5 cards
complexity.notes: Direct evaluation of poker hand conditions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking conditions out of precedence order can misclassify stronger hands.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies clear hierarchical conditionals in priority order.
